title: Data Broker Definition
description: Versioned JSON Schema for YAML broker files in the Symaira EraseMe registry. The versioned contract is documented in docs/registry-contract.md; schema_version must equal registry/manifest.json.

id.description: Unique identifier (lowercase, hyphenated). Must match the YAML file stem.

name.description: Full legal name of the broker.

category.description: Business category; the enum is the closed set of allowed values.

jurisdictions.description: Closed enum of the jurisdictions used by the registry (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 plus EU/UK registry conveniences).

laws.description: Privacy laws the broker is subject to; closed enum.

priority.description: Removal priority assigned by the registry maintainers.

opt_out.description: One or more opt-out channels (email and/or web form). At least one channel is required.

verification.description: Keyword sets used to classify broker replies. Optional.

disabled.description: When true, this broker is excluded from default plans and listings. Use when the broker entry is incomplete or known-broken (e.g. unverified CAPTCHA sitekey). Pair with notes explaining the reason.

added_date.description: ISO 8601 date when this broker entry was added to the registry.

source.description: Source registry or reference that verified this broker (e.g. 'California Data Broker Registry 2026', 'Vermont Data Broker Registry'). Only set when the source is known and verifiable.

status.description: Operational status of the broker entry.

type.description: Channel kind. Exactly one channel variant applies (see oneOf).

endpoint.description: Email address the opt-out request is sent to (email channels only).

url.description: Broker opt-out form URL (web_form channels only).

template.description: Letter template id used for email channels; optional on web_form channels (present when the form mirrors a template). Closed enum of the bundled templates.

locale.description: RFC 5646 language tag of the letter/request language.

required_fields.description: Identity fields the broker requires; closed enum of fields the identity store can supply.

supports_suppression.description: True when the broker accepts a suppression-list opt-out in addition to deletion.

expected_response_days.description: Expected response time in days, used for deadline tick scheduling.

endpoint.description: Email address the opt-out request is sent to.

formStep.description: One step in a symaira-browse form_spec. Standard DSL: goto/fill/select/click/wait keys map CSS selector -> value (use ${field_name} template syntax to interpolate identity fields).

goto.description: URL to navigate to. Use '.' for the form's own URL.

fill.description: CSS selector -> value mapping. Use ${full_name}, ${email} etc. for identity interpolation. Keys must look like CSS selectors (start with #, ., [, *, or a tag name) — the legacy {selector, from} shape is rejected.

select.description: CSS selector -> option value mapping (for <select> elements). Same key constraints as `fill`.

assert_text.description: Text that must appear on the page.

site_key.description: The CAPTCHA site key embedded in the broker's form. Must be a real key, not a placeholder.

is_invisible.description: True for invisible CAPTCHAs (hCaptcha, reCAPTCHA invisible).

verification.description: Keyword sets for classifying broker replies: ack (request accepted), rejection (refused), human_required (manual verification needed).
